source: Martin Orwin, Colloquial Somali, reduced verb forms; Zorc, Somali Reference Grammar and Somali-English Dictionary
rule: Past-progressive forms under focused-subject restrictive agreement use the same reduced person classes as the other restrictive paradigms while retaining ordinary main-clause past-progressive endings. The default class serves 1sg/2sg/3sg_m/2pl/3pl, 3sg_f remains distinct, and 1pl remains distinct.
